freePlan.limits: Free to browse, buy, and publish; itch.io takes a creator-chosen revenue share (0% to 30%) on paid sales instead of charging a subscription.

keyLimits.en: No subscription; itch.io instead takes a creator-chosen revenue share (0-30%, default around 10%) on paid sales.

cautions.en: Not a subscription product: creators set their own price (including pay-what-you-want) and choose itch.io's cut themselves, from 0% to 30%.

capabilities.en: Open marketplace for distributing independent games, prototypes, assets, and comics without an approval process.
Pay-what-you-want pricing with a creator-controlled revenue share (0-30%) instead of a fixed platform cut.
Analytics dashboard covering discovery, downloads, and engagement per project.
Support for pre-orders, early access, bundling, and crowdfunding campaigns.

limitations.en: No paid 'pro' tier with extra features; monetization depends entirely on direct sales, not platform-provided premium tools.
Discovery is not algorithmically curated in the way larger storefronts are, so visibility depends on the creator's own audience.

missingAlternatives.name: Steam / Steamworks
missingAlternatives.reason: Main competing distribution platform for indie games, already in the catalogue as steamworks.

unknowns: No page-count breakdown for platform fees on payment processing (Stripe/PayPal) separate from itch.io's own revenue share was found within budget.
